title: BCD Counter with Seven-Segment Display
description: A 4-bit counter drives a BCD decoder that lights a common-cathode seven-segment display.

education.summary: The counter outputs a binary number, the decoder converts it into the seven segment patterns, and the display shows the digit.
objectives: Match each segment output of the decoder to the display pin
Size the segment resistors from the supply and LED current
Explain what the lamp-test and blanking inputs do
questions: Which segments light for the count 7?
What value should the 330 Ω resistors be for 10 mA per segment at 5 V?
